micron.definition: n. a metric unit of length equal to one millionth of a meter

micronaire.translation: 马克隆尼气流式纤维细度测试仪

micronation.translation: [网络] 私人国家；微型国家；微国家

micronesia.definition:
n. a country scattered over Micronesia with a constitutional government in free association with the United States; achieved independence in 1986
n. the islands in the northwestern part of Oceania

micronesian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Micronesia, a collective
   designation of the islands in the western part of the Pacific Ocean,
   embracing the Marshall and Gilbert groups, the Ladrones, the Carolines,
   etc.
micronesian.translation:
n. 密克罗尼西亚的语言；密克罗尼西亚的人
a. 密克罗尼西亚语的；密克罗尼西亚人的

micronesians.definition:
n. pl. A dark race inhabiting the Micronesian Islands.
   They are supposed to be a mixed race, derived from Polynesians and
   Papuans.
micronesians.translation: [医]密克罗尼西亚人（西太平洋）

micronic.translation: a. 细微的；极为细小的

micronics.translation: (micronic 的复数) adj. 细微的；极为细小的

micronize.translation:
vt. 使微粉化
[医] 微粒化

microns.definition: n. a metric unit of length equal to one millionth of a meter
microns.translation: n. 微米( micron的复数形式 )

micronucleus.translation: n. [动]小核,微核(指原生动物纤毛虫类体内较小的细胞核, 有遗传功能)

micronutrient.definition: n. a substance needed only in small amounts for normal body function (e.g., vitamins or minerals)

n. 微量营养素
